readout.notes: Author server decider.serve (uvicorn, POST /v1/systemone). The engine is custom (batching, schema engine, shared prefix, FP8 optional) and the model name is "jev-latest" in BH's spec. Not an OpenAI logprobs API; not portable to llama.cpp or MLX.
readout.portable_notes: Unmodified author server supports CPU FP32 and Apple MPS FP16 via DECIDER_DEVICE; these are not BF16 variants. https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Mapika/decider/45024082b7d4bb667bf9140b7a7c073d3b483f6b/decider/serve.py L77: DEVICE = os.environ.get("DECIDER_DEVICE", "auto")                          # auto | cuda[:i] | mps | cpu; L382: dev = "cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else ("mps" if torch.backends.mps.is_available() else "cpu"); L396: return dev, default_dtype(dev); L419: if WARMUP and eng.use_graphs:                   # off CUDA there are no graphs to capture; every request runs eager. https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Mapika/decider/45024082b7d4bb667bf9140b7a7c073d3b483f6b/decider/infer.py L73: return torch.float16 if d.startswith("mps") else (torch.float32 if d.startswith("cpu") else torch.bfloat16). Disable FP8/compile and schema preload off CUDA; EngineV2 L51 disables CUDA graphs off CUDA, and the startup warmup is guarded. Author custom in-process model/head readout is not backend-agnostic. About 23.920 GB BF16/FP16 weights; CPU FP32 doubles them before activations.

steps: Clone github.com/Mapika/decider @ 45024082; install decider-ai 1.8.1 --no-deps -e into .venv312 (author serve.sh uses that venv path).
Download Mapika/decider-12b @ 8ac1efa7; check model.safetensors sha256 efb90aaf... and decider_config.json version "12b-v2".
Run the author scripts/serve.sh <snapshot> 8060 (uvicorn decider.serve:app on 127.0.0.1); DECIDER_* left at author defaults.
Adapter: jevbench typesafe, endpoint http://127.0.0.1:8060, model jev-latest, timeout 900 s.

variants.expected_speed: About 54 ms p 50 per decision (raw, serial) on the BH card. Provisioning class: RTX PRO 6000 96 GB; this names a memory class, not a latency measurement or confirmation of architecture compatibility. CPU/Mac speed is estimated only in separate portable variants.
variants.notes: min_vram_gb 60 from BH meta.json; recommended 96 is the BH card. The v1 revision decider-12b-v1 (Mapika/decider-12b @ 09e9e338, stock Gemma-4-12B-it, separate row) is NOT in this catalog entry; it is a separate BH row with its own readiness status. Weights 23.9 GB bf16. Host RAM provisioning estimate: pinned weight files sum to 23.920 GB; ×1.25 loader/runtime allowance rounded up to 4 GB gives 32 GB. This is not a measured peak; FP32 initialization or duplicate weight buffers may require more. Executable recipe provenance and runtime differences: catalog/TEXT-RECIPES-V2.md.
